notes.title: A Very Viking Yuletide!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! it's that time of year again, when the Kerberos gang takes a few days to relax, unwind, and prepare for the new year. It's also the time for people to play games together online and the Steam Winter Sale! 

So, we wanted to give you a little something special for the break, besides a chance to buy the game for friends and family at a Steam Winter Sale price - we've added some festive Viking avatars, which is nice, but it's just tinsel on the tree. The real present is the Holiday Boast Card, which gives you a new challenge and rewards a new style of play.

We hope you all have a wonderful holidays and we'll see you in the new year!

notes.title: Happy Holidays from the Hoards of Glory team!
notes.notes:
We want to thank everybody for checking out Hoards of Glory, our Viking-theme tabletop game turned into a fully realized digital boardgame.

As a token of our appreciation, before everybody nestled into the Winter holidays, we added a few things to our regular update. Besides the usual bugs stomped and AI tweaks, we added a fourth player Boast Card for you to try out against your friend and families. And for when things go your way - or especially when they don't - we've added a handful of vocal emotes your can bark out at your opponents (simply click on your player avatar next to your boast game and choose one).

If you haven't tried out Hoards of Glory, we hope you consider it - we think you'll find it's an easy to pick up game with lots of strategy and a certain amount of luck required. You can try it yourself against the AI, or play it multiplayer against human or AI opponents.

There's something satisfying about rolling a fist-full of dice! And we look forward to growing this latest addition to the Kerberos games catalog.

Have a happy holidays, be well, and we'll see you in 2021!
